# EL8 Tech

> Iraqi engineering studio that designs, builds, and ships software — web platforms, mobile apps, AI systems, desktop software, and hardware. Production-ready in weeks.

## What We Are
EL8 Tech is a software and hardware engineering studio based in Iraq. We take projects from concept to production with fast delivery and no shortcuts. Our team handles the full stack — from UI design to backend architecture to hardware integration.

## What We Build

### 1. Web & App Development
- Fast, responsive websites and web applications
- Built with modern frameworks (React, Next.js, Vite)
- Optimized for performance and conversion

### 2. Business & Management Systems
- Full enterprise platforms (ERP, CRM, HR, POS)
- Academic management systems with automated grading and evaluation
- Integrated dashboards with real-time reporting

### 3. AI & Data Solutions
- Custom AI model integration and conversational agents
- Computer vision, OCR, and document processing
- Data pipelines, analysis tools, and automated workflows

### 4. Desktop Software
- Native desktop applications for Windows, macOS, and Linux
- System-level automation and offline-first architecture
- Enterprise management and operations tools

### 5. Mobile Applications
- Cross-platform apps for iOS and Android
- Real-time sync, notifications, and offline support
- High-performance native experiences

### 6. Hardware & IoT
- Custom embedded systems and IoT controllers
- Sensor networks and hardware-software bridges
- POS hardware integration, barcode/RFID systems

## Featured Projects

### Raqeem Labs (مختبرات رقيم) — https://raqeem.study
Interactive virtual science labs for sixth-year science students (السادس العلمي). Over 50 experiments drawn chapter by chapter from the complete syllabus, each an interactive simulation the student drives directly — changing variables and watching the result respond live. Physics covers capacitors, electromagnetic induction and alternating current; chemistry covers eight chapters from thermodynamics to biochemistry. Canvas/WebGL graphics with a real-time physics engine, a fully Arabic RTL interface, mobile-first layout, full offline operation, and builds for web, Android and Windows. A public physics demo is available at the URL above.

**Status:** the chemistry and biology labs launch in October 2026, and an Android build arrives on Google Play in October 2026.
Case study: https://el8.dev/project/raqeem

### Hawza Um Al-Banin Online Seminary (حوزة أم البنين النسوية الإلكترونية) — https://hawzw.app
A complete e-learning and examination platform for an online women's seminary teaching across four academic levels. Student enrollment portal, daily audio lessons, verified daily attendance, exam administration with automatic grading, cumulative mid-term/final records, and digital certificate issuance. Built on React and Supabase PostgreSQL with row-level security; available on web, Android and Windows. An Android build arrives on Google Play in October 2026.
Case study: https://el8.dev/project/hawza

### EL8 Platform
Developer directory and project showcase — a portfolio hub for engineers and creators.
